items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I used to take it down for him and write it... I used to write the melody for him

ctx.x: Did Johnny Rider just write or improvise?

Johnny used to play on the saxophone, and I used to take it down for him and write it, like even on the show, I used to pass him a piece of music; I used to write things for him. The melody, but nothing else. I used to write the melody for him, you know?
